categoryReasons.schemaAndBindings: The single literal `random` request ID is used consistently in the manifest, status, data, and refresh control, with no unnecessary inputs or options.
categoryReasons.apiAndRequestDesign: The manifest calls the verified unauthenticated GET `/random` endpoint once on load and sets a 60-second cache for the rate-limited service.
categoryReasons.runtimeCompatibility: The template reads the raw response from `data.random`, checks documented loading/error status fields, and uses supported components and formatting helpers.
categoryReasons.goalFulfillment: The activity title, all listed practical fields, optional activity link, and manual refresh are present in the rendered success path.
categoryReasons.visualQuality: The 24px suggestion title and labeled fact grid create hierarchy, but the uniform seven-cell presentation remains visually conventional rather than especially delightful.
categoryReasons.responsiveAndTheme: The auto-fitting grid can collapse to one column and dimmed text uses theme-aware semantics, though the fixed 140px minimum and long facts may feel dense in the narrowest tile.
categoryReasons.loadingEmptyErrorSuccess: A skeleton, error alert with request details, missing-activity message, and populated success view cover the main request states.
categoryReasons.dailyUsefulness: The labeled refresh and complete practical details are useful, but the seven uniform facts make the compact tile more information-dense than necessary.
categoryReasons.complexityDiscipline: One cached request and a single data-driven grid avoid duplicate fetches, redundant controls, and decorative container nesting.
categoryReasons.accessibility: The refresh control and activity link have visible labels, while the facts use visible text labels and do not rely on color alone.
categoryReasons.actionSafety: The only action is the supported manual refresh of a read-only query; no mutation or automatic action is introduced.

strengths: Correct cached, single-request use of the verified random-activity endpoint.
Manual refresh is clearly labeled and uses the installed RefreshButton helper.
All practical response fields are represented with useful fallbacks.
problems: The repeated label/value grid is orderly but visually generic.
Seven facts can make the narrow-tile view tall and dense.
highestImpactFixes: Give the suggestion and the most decision-relevant constraints a more distinctive visual hierarchy while retaining the responsive facts grid.
Reduce the prominence or density of secondary facts in a narrow tile if the installed layout contract permits it.
